author: a save-file-converter user's MiSTer (via issue #118 / PR #127, 2022-05-29); committed by euan-forrester
what_it_is: Phantasy Star IV (USA) battery save that came off a MiSTer Genesis/MegaDrive core, per its file name and the test ('a MiSTer Genesis padded with zeros save'); game progress unknown. Packed (one byte per SRAM byte, not byte-expanded), 64 KB, padded with 0x00 rather than the 0xFF MiSTer normally pads with; the test author guesses the core keeps whatever padding the file it was given had. Which MiSTer core version wrote it is not stated.
note: File name kept as downloaded; MiSTer itself would name it after the ROM with a .sav extension.
